title: Spicy Tofu Tagine
description: An Indian-inspired dish that combines the flavors of a traditional tagine with the versatility of tofu.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: firm, drained, and cut into small cubes

ingredients.name: acrid
ingredients.notes: ground or whole spices, adjust to taste

ingredients.name: algerian
ingredients.notes: ground or whole spices, adjust to taste

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add onion and ginger; sauté until softened.
Add tofu; fry until golden brown.
Add tagine, acrid, and algerian spice mix; stir well.
